description:
Title: Farming Bot

Players want to create custom farming bots, that help them gather resources.
First you have to find out which resources you want.
Up to 10 resources in parallel can be collected, some resources are more urgently needed than others.
Some resources are required to create tools that are needed to gather other resources (create a custom logic of the dependencies in your game).
After all preferences are collected, your bot starts farming.
Sometimes,  random natural disasters strike and set your bot back.
Whenever some milestones are reached, you are notified.
During farming it is possible to update the list of to be farmed materials (at all times).
After the bot is finished, you should be able to brag to selected friends and/or send them materials.
generated_bpmn_xml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/farming-bot">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Brag" name="Brag"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Materials" name="Materials"/>
  <bpmn:signal id="Signal_NaturalDisaster" name="Natural disaster strikes"/>
  <bpmn:signal id="Signal_MilestoneReached" name="Milestone reached"/>
  <bpmn:signal id="Signal_ListUpdateRequested" name="Farming list update requested"/>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_FarmingBot" name="Farming Bot" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Begin" name="Begin bot setup"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SelectResources" name="Select resources to farm"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SetUrgency" name="Set resource urgency"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_DefineDependencies" name="Define resource and tool dependencies"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_StartFarming" name="Start bot farming"/>

    <bpmn:subProcess id="SubProcess_Farming" name="Farm resources">
      <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Farming" name="Begin farming"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_CollectResources" name="Collect selected resources (up to 10 in parallel)"/>
      <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Farming" name="Farming finished"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Farming_1" sourceRef="StartEvent_Farming" targetRef="Task_CollectResources"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Farming_2" sourceRef="Task_CollectResources" targetRef="EndEvent_Farming"/>

      <bpmn:subProcess id="SubProcess_Disaster" name="Handle natural disaster" triggeredByEvent="true">
        <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Disaster" name="Natural disaster strikes" isInterrupting="false">
          <bpmn:signalEventDefinition id="SignalEventDefinition_Disaster" signalRef="Signal_NaturalDisaster"/>
        </bpmn:startEvent>
        <bpmn:task id="Task_ApplySetback" name="Apply setback to bot"/>
        <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Disaster" name="Setback applied"/>
        <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Disaster_1" sourceRef="StartEvent_Disaster" targetRef="Task_ApplySetback"/>
        <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Disaster_2" sourceRef="Task_ApplySetback" targetRef="EndEvent_Disaster"/>
      </bpmn:subProcess>

      <bpmn:subProcess id="SubProcess_Milestone" name="Notify on milestone" triggeredByEvent="true">
        <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Milestone" name="Milestone reached" isInterrupting="false">
          <bpmn:signalEventDefinition id="SignalEventDefinition_Milestone" signalRef="Signal_MilestoneReached"/>
        </bpmn:startEvent>
        <bpmn:task id="Task_NotifyMilestone" name="Notify player"/>
        <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Milestone" name="Player notified"/>
        <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Milestone_1" sourceRef="StartEvent_Milestone" targetRef="Task_NotifyMilestone"/>
        <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Milestone_2" sourceRef="Task_NotifyMilestone" targetRef="EndEvent_Milestone"/>
      </bpmn:subProcess>

      <bpmn:subProcess id="SubProcess_UpdateList" name="Update farming list" triggeredByEvent="true">
        <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_ListUpdate" name="Farming list update requested" isInterrupting="false">
          <bpmn:signalEventDefinition id="SignalEventDefinition_ListUpdate" signalRef="Signal_ListUpdateRequested"/>
        </bpmn:startEvent>
        <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EditList" name="Update list of materials to farm"/>
        <bpmn:task id="Task_ApplyList" name="Apply updated farming list"/>
        <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_ListUpdate" name="Farming list updated"/>
        <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ListUpdate_1" sourceRef="StartEvent_ListUpdate" targetRef="Task_EditList"/>
        <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ListUpdate_2" sourceRef="Task_EditList" targetRef="Task_ApplyList"/>
        <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ListUpdate_3" sourceRef="Task_ApplyList" targetRef="EndEvent_ListUpdate"/>
      </bpmn:subProcess>
    </bpmn:subProcess>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ShareDecision" name="Share with friends?" default="Flow_Share_No"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ChooseSharing" name="Choose whether to brag and/or send materials"/>
    <bpmn:inclusiveGateway id="Gateway_SharingSplit" name="Choose sharing actions"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_Brag" name="Brag to selected friends" messageRef="Message_Brag"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendMaterials" name="Send materials to selected friends" messageRef="Message_Materials"/>
    <bpmn:inclusiveGateway id="Gateway_SharingJoin" name="Finish selected sharing actions"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ShareMerge" name="Continue after sharing"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Complete" name="Bot finished"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_1" sourceRef="StartEvent_Begin" targetRef="Task_SelectResources"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_2" sourceRef="Task_SelectResources" targetRef="Task_SetUrgency"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_3" sourceRef="Task_SetUrgency" targetRef="Task_DefineDependencies"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_4" sourceRef="Task_DefineDependencies" targetRef="Task_StartFarming"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_5" sourceRef="Task_StartFarming" targetRef="SubProcess_Farming"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_6" sourceRef="SubProcess_Farming" targetRef="Gateway_ShareDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Share_Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_ShareDecision" targetRef="Task_ChooseSharing">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance">The player chooses to share with friends</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Share_No" sourceRef="Gateway_ShareDecision" targetRef="Gateway_ShareMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Choose_ToSplit" sourceRef="Task_ChooseSharing" targetRef="Gateway_SharingSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Brag" sourceRef="Gateway_SharingSplit" targetRef="Task_Brag">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance">Bragging is selected</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Materials" sourceRef="Gateway_SharingSplit" targetRef="Task_SendMaterials">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance">Sending materials is selected</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Brag_Join" sourceRef="Task_Brag" targetRef="Gateway_SharingJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Materials_Join" sourceRef="Task_SendMaterials" targetRef="Gateway_SharingJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Sharing_ToMerge" sourceRef="Gateway_SharingJoin" targetRef="Gateway_ShareMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Merge_End" sourceRef="Gateway_ShareMerge" targetRef="EndEvent_Complete"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_FarmingBot">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_FarmingBot" name="Farming Bot" processRef="Process_FarmingBot"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Friends" name="Selected friends"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Brag" name="Brag" sourceRef="Task_Brag" targetRef="Participant_Friends" messageRef="Message_Brag"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Materials" name="Materials" sourceRef="Task_SendMaterials" targetRef="Participant_Friends" messageRef="Message_Materials"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>
</bpmn:definitions>
